# R4.7e — Live judge binding — `CriticDeclaration{kind=judge}` at `link`, calibration, independence (DF-S1.21-3)

Spec: `docs/tickets/156e_R4.7e__live-judge-binding.md` (seq 156e).
Depends on R4.7d (stacked; base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.7d` @
`2e187e5`). Requirement ids: **DF-S1.21-3** · **DF-S1.21-2** ·
**BL-17** · **BL-05** · **R-2.7.1** · **R-2.7.2b** · **R-2.7.3** ·
**ADR-0300** · **ADR-0311** · **ADR-0347** · **ADR-0348**.

## Summary

- **`crates/hh-embed/src/judge_adapters.rs`** (new, 1,223 lines) — the
  live judge binding surface: `link_judge` arms a `LiveJudge` over a
  `BoundLane`'s `GatewayModel` (profile → endpoint, credential coordinate
  carried by name only); `link_judged_pair` binds the different-family
  panel. `declare_critic` is consumed in full at link — the declared
  calibration set folds a `CalibrationRecord` per judge (uncalibrated
  stays `exploratory`, `GateWithoutCalibration` declines judged gate
  evidence), the snapshot axis is *derived* from the beneficiary family
  facts (an overclaim refuses and re-bases — `different_family` hosted /
  `different_snapshot_same_family` local), and `RedundantJudge` refuses
  duplicate judge profiles. `PanelJudge` reduces decided members at the
  minimum confidence and records withheld members durable.
- **`hh-control` `JudgePort`** widened additively —
  `assess`/`take_records`/`take_model_io` with defaulted abstentions:
  `RecordedJudge` stays the offline replay binding (buffers nothing,
  replays recorded verdicts byte-identically, `has_recording`-gated —
  ADR-0347 D3 composes, never replaces).
- **`Driver::drain_judge_records`** — the fenced drain lands buffered
  `hh.model_io/1` blobs through `StoreSeam` *before* the
  `verification.validator.*` rows that cite them (durable-before-visible,
  CC3): at G-INTERPRET and — the live leg's catch — between the
  completion gate's `assess` consults and the `claim.reconciled` rows.
  Buffered io against a seam-less sink surfaces `DriverError`, never
  drops.
- **The R-2.7.2b judged arm live** — the completion gate consults each
  bound critic (`assess`), folds `reconcile_judged` per critic ref, and
  mints `claim.reconciled{detector = judged}` records carrying the
  member's own `calibration_ref` + `independence_summary`; uncalibrated
  consults are declined (`JudgedWithoutCalibration`, never a fabricated
  ref). Judged records are veto-admissible evidence, never
  hold-admissible (F7 — the deterministic fold alone decides the gate).
- **Two latent defects the live leg surfaced and fixed** —
  `verification.claim.recorded` carried a closed `model_call_id` event
  scope (`ScopeNotOpen` on the real `Store`; appended scope-free, the
  payload ref retained) and the completion-gate `assess` `model_io`
  never drained (the strengthened leg failed honestly — `the driver
  left judge model_io undrained` — before the fix landed).

### Live evidence (`hh-live-evidence/1`, ADR-0363 — live-executed layer)

| Leg | Record | Result | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| `judge-calibrate` | `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-judge-calibrate.json` + redacted transcript | **pass** — both judges 6/6 decided, agreement_ppm=1,000,000, consistency_ppm=1,000,000; `live_calibrations.json` evidence | USD 0.001722 |
| `judge-run` | `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-judge-run.json` + redacted transcript | **pass** — real `Driver` run `Completed`; `JUDGE_LINK` two families (local `openai-compatible@1` + hosted `openai@1`); 5 judged verdicts, 2 per-critic `claim.reconciled{judged}` (local `diverge/censored_evidence` @ 100k ppm vs hosted `agree` @ 1M ppm — real two-family disagreement on a real claim); 5 `hh.model_io/1` blobs; `RecordedJudge` replay byte-identical (`has_recording`-gated) | USD 0.001945 |

Spend: R4.7e ≈ USD 7.01 of the USD 15 allocation (6 failed-attempt
debits at the declared USD 1 budget — the spend ledger's conservative
honest accounting — plus the two measured passes and the earlier
0.001786 pass superseded by the strengthened leg); cumulative
21.257705 vs the USD 100 cap. Provider markers only (`provided: yes`)
— no credential values in any record, transcript, fixture or this
body; transcripts redacted via `hh-secret-scan` before commit.

Honest limits: an earlier leg recorded the local judge's loop consult
as typed `oracle_failure` (provider-degraded response — durable, never
converted to confidence); the final pass's local judge decided on both
consults. The recorded panel verdict's replay is 0 ppm — honestly so:
neither judge reported loop evidence on this run; the replay assertion
is `has_recording`-gated so the fold was non-trivial.
